description: This Java class represents the response to a RetrieveConfig command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates a configuration object (as JSON) along with relevant headers, providing functionality for JSON serialization/deserialization, equality checks, and header management.

classes.name: RetrieveConfigResponse
classes.description: A response message for retrieving configuration data, including a JSON configuration payload and standard response methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveConfigResponse with specified config JSON object and headers.

methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveConfigResponse from a JSON object and headers, extracting the 'config' field.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the config payload to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object, considering the config JSON payload.
